Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Hans Gylling wrote:
>
> Can anyone please tell me how many rares, uncommons, commons and vampires
> (or cards from the vampire sheet) you get in a Jyhad booster and in a
> Jyhad starter.

Type of card Booster Starter
------------ ------- -------
Rare 1 (5.3%) 2 (2.6%)
Uncommon 3 (15.8%) 13 (17.1%)
Commmon 11 (57.9%) 45 (59.2%)
Vampire * 4 (21.0%) 16 (21.0%)
---- ----
Total 19 76

* there may not be 4/16 actual vampires: some of the spaces on the
vampire sheet are taken up with vote cards.

> How many different rares, uncommons, commons, and vampires are there in the
> Jyhad set.

Rares: 92 on a 121 sheet (29 are duplicated)
Uncommon: 103 on a 121 sheet (18 are duplicated)
Common: 121 on a 121 sheet
Vampire: 111 vamps + 10 votes on a 121 sheet

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com) VTES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
